user:
CREATE TABLE `user` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'constraints required; auto incremented primary key',
  `username` varchar(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'short unique user alias for log in purpose',
  `ips_user_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'user which will be used for validating credentials in IPS',
  `first_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'first name for user',
  `last_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'last name for user',
  `email` varchar(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'unique email per user for communication purpose',
  `password` varchar(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'hashed password for log in',
  `pin` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '$2b$12$DKsf4ZIOPfDrAr03IEX3Cu34.Qa9ODqZC0Yp6y3SA9vHgvr.8gSFa' COMMENT '6 digit hashed pin which is required when front end locks user',
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1' COMMENT 'flag which marks user as inactive in case of wrong login attempts',
  `last_login` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'last login time for user',
  `failed_login_count` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'counts failed login attempts for the user',
  `is_locked` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'marks user as locked in case of failed login attempts',
  `company_id` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'company id for the user',
  `is_dosepack_admin` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'flag which represents if user is dosepack admin',
  `image_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'profile pic name for the user which is stored in gcloud storage',
  `idle_time` int DEFAULT '300' COMMENT 'idle time for the user',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `username` (`username`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`),
  KEY `company_id` (`company_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `user_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`company_id`) REFERENCES `company` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=4 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Table for storing user info in table'
